description: The Title 17 process to become a Regional Center provider via the Provider Directory portal.

sections.title: Provider Directory Intake & Program Design
sections.summary: Align your facility with the Regional Center's specific needs through the digital workflow.

bullets.label: Requirements Stage Intake
bullets.detail: Submit initial vendor/applicant information, service location, and licenses in the Provider Directory to verify you meet minimum requirements[cite: 1127]. The Regional Center has 15 calendar days to process this stage[cite: 1099, 1100].

bullets.label: Finalize & Upload Program Design
bullets.detail: During the Submission Stage, which has a 30 calendar day processing timeframe[cite: 1106, 1850], upload your detailed Program Design (often 30-50 pages) describing your service model, staffing ratios, and how you will meet the needs of Regional Center consumers.

bullets.label: Determine Service Level (1-4)
bullets.detail: Your rate is determined by the level of care (Level 2, 3, or 4A-I). Higher levels require more specialized staffing and more intensive Program Designs.

bullets.label: System-Generated DS 1890 & DS 1891
bullets.detail: Do not request manual forms from the Regional Center[cite: 1552]. The Provider Directory automatically generates drafts of the Vendor Application (DS 1890) and Applicant/Vendor Disclosure Statement (DS 1891). Review, modify the DS 1891 if needed, and e-sign them via AdobeSign[cite: 1809, 1819, 1830].

sections.title: Decision Stage, Contracts & Rates
sections.summary: Establishing the financial pipeline for monthly reimbursements and finalizing approval.

bullets.label: Vendorization Checklist & Decision
bullets.detail: Upload the Vendor Agreement as part of the Vendorization Checklist[cite: 1584]. The Regional Center has 45 days in the Decision Stage to render an approval or denial and issue your unique Vendor ID[cite: 1115, 1116, 1117].

bullets.label: Setup e-Billing (e-Billing System)
bullets.detail: Most California Regional Centers use the EDI/e-Billing portal. You will need to learn the 'Attendance' and 'Invoice' submission workflow to get paid.

sections.title: Placement & Ongoing Monitoring
sections.summary: Moving from an empty house to a fully staffed residential facility.

bullets.label: Host the Facility Liaison Visit
bullets.detail: The Regional Center Liaison will visit your home to verify it matches your Program Design before they send the first 'Referral Packet' for a resident.

bullets.label: Execute Admission Agreements
bullets.detail: This is the contract between the Licensee, the Resident, and the Regional Center. It must comply with both Title 22 and Title 17 standards.
